key_insight: Matrix-structured optimizers, especially SOAP and SOAP-Muon, can train NequIP and Allegro faster and to better final accuracy than Adam for ML interatomic potentials.
engineering_relevance: Optimizer choice is an overlooked but high-impact tuning axis for scientific ML, with strong gains for label-efficient and force-supervised atomistic model training.
method: Implemented and compared Adam, Muon, SOAP, and SOAP-Muon.
Trained NequIP and Allegro MLIP models under full and partial force supervision.
Benchmarked convergence speed and final predictive accuracy across optimizers.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic evaluation on MLIP training and states that SOAP and SOAP-Muon are consistently strongest, with the biggest improvements under partial force supervision.
watch_item: Results are shown for specific MLIP architectures, so gains may depend on model type, training setup, and the extra complexity of matrix-structured optimizer implementation.
paper_title: Beyond Adam: SOAP and Muon for Faster, Label-Efficient Training of Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
